name: add-months-clamp
prompt: Customers billed on the 31st get their next invoice dated in the wrong month: addMonths(Jan 31, 1) returns March 2 instead of February 29 (in 2024). Fix addMonths in src/dates.js: when the target month is shorter, clamp to its last day. It must keep the time of day, work for negative n and across years, and must not modify the date passed in.
